scope: Declared conceptual scope only; implementation details outside the question are not required.

questions.expected: Training uses paired images and natural-language descriptions, without requiring a predetermined class vocabulary; at use time candidate class descriptions are encoded for matching. A schematic word example must not make that distinction unreadable.
All-pairs image/text similarities, diagonal paired examples, both retrieval directions with a symmetric training objective.
Image and text encoders are learned in pre-training and reused at zero-shot use; class descriptions define candidates without a new task-trained head or task-specific training.
Cross-modal alignment enables reuse with language-provided classes. No numerical performance or exact loss formula is established by the picture.
